newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves equity hike for Modi Telstra.
newsitem.headline: India approves equity hike for Modi Telstra.

text.p: India's Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment (CCFI) has approved a proposal by mobile phone service firm Modi Telstra Private Ltd to enhance its paid-up capital to 970 million rupees from 400 million, the government said in a statement on Thursday.
India's Modi group holds 51 percent and Australia's Telstra group 49 percent in the joint venture.

The statement said foreign equity in the venture held by the Telstra group would rise to 475.3 million rupees from 196 million rupees. A part of it, amounting to 230.3 million rupees would be held by Telstra South Asia Holdings, it added. ($1=35.8 rupees)
